title: TX queue: reject ambiguous absolute deadlines
description: Robustness review of project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.8.17.17.1 found that tx_queue_push() documents deadline_ms as less than 2^31 ms ahead of current uptime but does not enforce the precondition. deadline_expired() uses half-range modular comparison, so a caller-supplied deadline more than INT32_MAX milliseconds ahead can be accepted and then treated as expired, yielding a successful enqueue followed by an unexpected drop. Validate the signed half-range after reading the clock and before mutating queue state; reject already-expired and too-far-ahead absolute deadlines consistently with -EINVAL. Add exact-boundary and wraparound tests.
acceptance_criteria: tx_queue_push rejects deadlines at/past now and deadlines more than INT32_MAX milliseconds ahead; accepts now+INT32_MAX including across uint32 wrap. Per the canonical push order, existing stale entries may expire and update deadline-drop stats before rejection; the invalid incoming packet itself is never admitted and does not change full/preemption stats. Existing default deadlines and expiry behavior remain green under ASan/UBSan.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by host sanitizer suite plus review cycle; superseding round-4 findings are tracked separately
